mapper.sql: id, locker_id, box_number, box_size, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM t_box ORDER BY locker_id, box_number

SELECT
FROM t_box WHERE locker_id = #{lockerId} ORDER BY box_number

SELECT
FROM t_box WHERE locker_id = #{lockerId} AND box_size = #{boxSize} AND status = 1 ORDER BY box_number LIMIT 1

SELECT b.id, b.locker_id, b.box_number, b.box_size, b.status, CASE b.status WHEN 1 THEN '空闲' WHEN 2 THEN '占用' WHEN 0 THEN '禁用' ELSE '未知' END AS status_desc, l.locker_name, l.location AS locker_location, NULL AS package_id, NULL AS package_no, NULL AS receiver_name, b.create_time, b.update_time FROM t_box b LEFT JOIN t_locker l ON b.locker_id = l.id WHERE b.status = 1 ORDER BY b.locker_id, b.box_number
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_box (locker_id, box_number, box_size, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{lockerId}, #{boxNumber}, #{boxSize}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.locker_id, b.box_number, b.box_size, b.status, CASE b.status WHEN 1 THEN '空闲' WHEN 2 THEN '占用' WHEN 0 THEN '禁用' ELSE '未知' END AS status_desc, l.locker_name, l.location AS locker_location, p.id AS package_id, p.package_no, p.receiver_name, b.create_time, b.update_time FROM t_box b LEFT JOIN t_locker l ON b.locker_id = l.id LEFT JOIN t_package p ON b.id = p.box_id AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY l.id, b.box_number

SELECT b.id, b.locker_id, b.box_number, b.box_size, b.status, CASE b.status WHEN 1 THEN '空闲' WHEN 2 THEN '占用' WHEN 0 THEN '禁用' ELSE '未知' END AS status_desc, l.locker_name, l.location AS locker_location, p.id AS package_id, p.package_no, p.receiver_name, b.create_time, b.update_time FROM t_box b LEFT JOIN t_locker l ON b.locker_id = l.id LEFT JOIN t_package p ON b.id = p.box_id AND p.status = 1 WHERE b.id = #{id}
